PROJECT 03

Union
Cemetery

Overview

A chronological reconstruction of Union Cemetery in Columbus, turning burial records and section maps into a landscape that can be explored through space and time.

RoleResearch / Visualization / Development
PlatformInteractive 3D / Web
StackPython / Blender / HTML / JavaScript
Dataset78,000+ Burial Records

Problem

Records without landscape

Burial records identify people, dates, sections, and lots, but the chronology is difficult to understand when the data is separated from the physical cemetery.

Response

Rebuild the site through time

The project links cleaned burial data to mapped cemetery geometry so the site can be viewed as a changing landscape across months and years.

Workflow

Four linked stages

The visualization combines archival records, section maps, spatial placement, and chronological animation.

ParseMapPlaceAnimate

02 / Prototype

3D visualization prototype

Explore the cemetery as a navigable 3D landscape. Orbit the site, pan across the grounds, zoom into sections, and move through month-and-year chronology as graves and trees appear and mature over time.

TimelineMonth + year progression from January 1806
NavigationFree 3D orbit, pan, section focus, and zoom
BurialsDated graves appear by chronology with road exclusion and plot spacing
LandscapeElevation, grass, roads, and trees that grow with the timeline
